purpose: Teach: 州立/施主/廻っ/下層/席上/呼応/デマンド/無休

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、州立研究機関への留学も視野
lines.en: Ren, have you considered a research placement at a state institution?
lines.style: Measured, inviting—not a command but a thoughtful opening. Slight pause before his name. Warm regard settling into quiet professionalism. The tone of someone testing whether you're ready for the next thing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。建築研究の施主の声を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll listen closely to what the clients need in architectural research.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Quick intake of breath before answering—showing he's been waiting for this. Even cadence, no rush. The voice of someone who takes notes mentally as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室を廻って見識を深めろ
lines.en: Ren, go around the labs yourself. Deepen what you see.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Each phrase lands deliberately. Leans into the verb—「廻って」gets weight. Not lecturing; instructing the way someone who believes you'll listen would.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。下層研究員の声も汲み取ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll take on board what even the junior researchers are saying.
lines.style: Respectful precision. Slightly braced—this is a harder commitment than before. Steady breath. The careful speech of someone who understands he's being asked to notice things others might miss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会の席上での発表は緊張するか
lines.en: Ren, will presenting at the conference make you nervous?
lines.style: Direct inquiry with underlying warmth. No judgment in the question—genuine curiosity. A slight lean forward in the phrasing. Testing whether he's thought about what comes next.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先行研究に呼応する論文を書きます
lines.en: Yes. I'm writing a paper that responds to the existing research.
lines.style: Measured response—he's deflecting slightly but not dishonestly. Soft on the opening word. The rhythm of someone building something. Not quite answering the anxiety question, but showing he's prepared anyway.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、市場のデマンドも研究テーマに
lines.en: Ren, let market demand shape your research direction too.
lines.style: Final instruction—slightly more weight than the earlier ones. Authoritative without edge. A small pause before the final thought. The voice of someone closing a conversation by opening a door.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験室を無休で稼働させます
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep the laboratory running without breaks.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. The words land like a vow. No hesitation. Slight tighten in the throat—he understands what he's committing to. Final cadence trails slightly, absorbing the weight of what he's just said.
